div.div: VERDICT — CLOSED. Entry premise: 'M15 band-state flip predicts direction.' Measured: V36.13 M15-alone = -$899, PF 0.61, 214 trades, NOT-SEPARABLE (winners/losers indistinguishable at entry across all features incl HTF). V36.14 M30-confirmed = PF 0.71 OOS (n=169, PRE 0.66 / POST 0.88). The exit is the loss channel (M15_REVERT = 87.6% of gross loss), but the revert-split is MIXED so it cannot be simply loosened. Three confirmation levels (M15-alone, HTF-filtered, M30-confirmed) all failed out-of-sample. Documented CLOSED in DUALTF_ARCHITECTURE.md. Part 3 identification remains valid; only this M15-flip trade premise is dead.
